# hivelocity_webhook (Resource)

Registers a webhook that is called when an account event fires. The list of events is available from the `hivelocity_webhook_events` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_webhook_events" "all" {}

resource "hivelocity_webhook" "device_power" {
  name  = "Notify ops on power changes"
  event = "device.power"
  url   = "https://ops.example.com/hooks/hivelocity"
  headers = {
    Authorization = "Bearer ${var.hook_token}"
  }
}

variable "hook_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event` (String) Name of the event that triggers the webhook.
- `name` (String) Display name of the webhook.
- `url` (String) URL that receives the event payload.

### Optional

- `headers` (Map of String) Extra HTTP headers sent with the request, for example an authorization token.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `webhook_id` (Number) Unique ID of the webhook.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the webhook ID
terraform import hivelocity_webhook.device_power 42
```
